page_title: ALA 0-1 ESP | Alaves v Espanyol 22/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Joan Jordan (Alaves) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.

90+7' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Juan Pulido with no other option than to blow for a foul. Alaves are awarded a free kick.
90+5' A dangerous towering header by Jon Guridi (Alaves) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
90+5' Carles Alena (Alaves) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+3' The referee allows time for a substitution. Moussa Diarra will be replaced by Jon Guridi (Alaves).
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
88' Pau Cabanes (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Joan Garcia comes off his line to gather the ball.

86' 0 - 1 Goal! Fernando Calero (Espanyol) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Alvaro Tejero, and he steers a powerful header from near the penalty spot low inside the left post. What a finish that is - 0:1!
86' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) commits a rough challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for an infringement.
84' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
83' Eduardo Coudet prepares a substitution. Nahuel Tenaglia is replaced by Manu Sanchez (Alaves).
83' Substitution. Antonio Blanco walks off the pitch and Ander Guevara (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.

82' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Antonio Sivera.
81' The referee blows his whistle as Joan Jordan (Alaves) was too aggressive in his challenge.
81' Alaves keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
78' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Pulido interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
76' Joan Jordan (Alaves) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
74' Manolo Gonzalez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Pere Milla suffers an injury and Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) comes on.
74' Joan Jordan (Alaves) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
74' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Juan Pulido blows for a foul.
73' Pere Milla (Espanyol) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
70' Pere Milla (Espanyol) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fernando Calero (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch so that Javi Puado can be given a rest.
67' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Jofre will be replaced by Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol).
65' Juan Pulido shows a yellow card to Antonio Blanco (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
63' Kike Garcia (Alaves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Toni Martinez departs the field of play to be replaced by Asier Villalibre (Alaves).
62' Juan Pulido has a clear sight and sees a foul from Antonio Blanco (Alaves).
59' Alaves are seeing far more of the ball now.
57' Pol Lozano will be replaced by Pere Milla (Espanyol).
56' Kike Garcia (Alaves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
54' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
53' Jofre (Espanyol) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
53' Referee Juan Pulido signals NO PENALTY for Alaves after a VAR review!
52' Play continues despite the shouts by some Alaves players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Pulido interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
52' Carles Alena (Alaves) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
51' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
49' Alaves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Eduardo Coudet makes a switch. Pau Cabanes (Alaves) is coming on in place of Carlos Vicente at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' Juan Pulido has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Santiago Mourino (Alaves) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Joan Garcia is equal to it and makes an easy save.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Alex Kral (Espanyol) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
43' Neat passing move from Alaves in order to create new attacking opportunities.
41' Kike Garcia (Alaves) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots low towards goal, but Joan Garcia makes a magnificent save!
39' Joan Jordan (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
38' The ball possession is 62:38.
35' A pass from Javi Puado (Espanyol) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
33' Javi Puado (Espanyol) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
32' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Toni Martinez (Alaves), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
31' Toni Martinez (Alaves) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
30' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' The corner from Joan Jordan (Alaves) is intercepted by the defence.

27' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
26' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
25' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
24' Carles Alena (Alaves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
23' Alex Kral (Espanyol) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Alex Kral (Espanyol) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
21' Javi Puado (Espanyol) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
19' Joan Jordan (Alaves) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
17' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
16' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes a short corner kick.
15' Rough tackle by Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
14' The game is interrupted. Kike Garcia (Alaves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
14' Alaves control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Abdel Abqar (Alaves) and blew his whistle.
9' The ball is cleared after Carlos Vicente (Alaves) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
7' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
6' Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
5' Juan Pulido blows for a foul after Moussa Diarra (Alaves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
4' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Alaves will take the kick-off.
Juan Pulido is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
